description: Timer — runs an artifact's operation on a schedule (every N minutes, daily at a time, or once). It acts on a key its owner issues when they arm it, over the timer's workspace, and stops when the key is revoked or the timer is disarmed. Lumen fires it.

timer.description: schedule (one of every_minutes, daily_at HH:MM UTC, at ISO time), target {artifact_id, operation, body}, optional results_to, enabled

timer_state.description: Written by Lumen on each run: last_run, last_status, last_error, runs

key.description: The key the timer acts on: api_key_id, resources, armed_at. Never the secret
